newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Regal Hotels eyes China, U.S. acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Regal Hotels eyes China, U.S. acquisition.

text.p: Hong Kong's Regal Hotels International Holdings Ltd said it would buy new hotels in China and the United States this year, a Hong Kong newspaper said on Sunday.
The Sunday Morning Post quoted the group's chairman Lo Yuk-sui as saying Regal planned to buy another hotel in the Chinese city of Shanghai, its second in the city.
"We expect to open another five-star hotel in Shanghai this year. We hope to announce details shortly," Lo told the Post.
He said Regal would buy more than one new hotel in the U.S. this year. "It is on our agenda to expand our portfolio of quality acquisitions at the right price," Lo said.
Regal's next purchase in the U.S. was likely to be in New York, a location the firm had been considering for some years, he said, adding that negotiations for a new hotel were at an advanced stage.

Regal was also interested in other gateway cities in the U.S. such as Atlanta and San Francisco. Last year, the group added the Biltmore Hotel in Los Angeles and the Bostonian Hotel in Boston to its U.S. portfolio.
Officials from the company were not immediately available for comment. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6441
